scope: Stage one exact validated source revision under its originating live protection, sharing revalidated typed chunks and the existing physical dependency transaction. No durable task pin, task/control selection, GC/resume/activation permit, advertised capability or default-format change.
verification: Eighteen native regressions. Exact original v0/v1 source records after current alias replacement and reopen, all five hashes, mixed record/chunk flags and supported identity domains, plain/compressed chunks, empty bodies.

Actual byte-stability and counter-regression failures preceded fixes. Exact repeat and collision readback now precede the shared publisher baseline flush; generic transaction/KV semantics are unchanged.

Ordered in-memory chunk representation evidence survives exact relocation with different offsets/timestamps/write sequences and rejects changed representation, missing/wrong-role/corrupt chunks, owner/fence changes and regressed counters.
Cumulative chunk-validation byte/work limits, invalid bounds/times, fallible entity/readback/receipt allocations, accounting release and retries, final cancellation/pressure/protection validation.
Two synchronized native contenders validate the same frontier: one publishes and the stale contender refuses, then exact retry is byte-stable. No root/KV lock is held during the live validation pass.

Existing dependency observers exercise every precommit stage, committed postcondition failure and commit-wins-cancellation. Hard-failure admission stays refused until reopen; committed receipts remain truthful.
Five narrow plus115affected targets, full native libraries, architecture, strict Clippy, formatting, audit/debt and independent reference gates on Linux/macOS/Windows.
